name: oh-my-agents
description: Lean harness-engineering plugin for Claude Code: four pillars (architecture, documentation, observability, entropy) enforced as repo-local mechanical constraints. Composes with gstack (v1.46+ floor, v1.79 current; reconciles its content-addressed review verdicts read-only) for delivery — never orchestrates. Emits versioned verify/review decision signals (a Gate API per docs/SIGNALS.md — commit + dirty-tree freshness, typed findings) so Dynamic Workflows, Agent Teams, and the pre-ship convention check advance without human round-trips. 11 skills, 7 hooks (SessionStart gate-state injection + Stop termination sensor), 1 read-only audit workflow (/harness-audit).
